messages:
emma: alert from preview-dashboard: small systematic uptick in invoice-preview for routes serviced by ingest-proxy-canary starting 16:05 UTC. spikes align with optimistic_acks metric :frowning:
ravi: thanks — i saw the canary push earlier. ops-bot shows deploy 1779504319 at 16:03 UTC.
ops-bot: deploy 1779504319 to ingest-proxy-canary succeeded at 16:03 UTC (by ravi).
lex: quick triage: optimistic_ack= true causes proxy to emit an early_ack event on stream-establish. downstream tallyer treats any ack event as authoritative and increments token counters. if final delivery also emits, we get double-counts.
emma: that matches preview diffs: +0.6% for affected tenants, concentrated on routes with session_reuse. not large but customers will notice if applied.
metering-bot: preview-consumer reported duplicate-event-rate 0.8% for shard-2 between 16:05-16:20.
ravi: immediate mitigation: pause canary rollout and set optimistic_ack=false. ops can flip flag?
ops-bot: feature-flag optimistic_ack set to false for ingest-proxy-canary by ops at 16:09 UTC. rollout paused.
lex: good. next: short-term, billing — can you hold auto-apply for previews that reference ingest-proxy-canary host until we dedupe?
billing: yes, we can hold auto-apply for previews filtered by route_source=ingest-proxy-canary. send tenant list/time window.
emma: i'll export tenant_ids for 16:00-16:20 and attach to ENGPLAT-9402.
ravi: for long-term, propose a metering contract change: billing increments only on event.type == "final_delivery". early_ack and stream_open events become telemetry-only. that avoids protocol races when proxies attempt optimistic behavior.
lex: agree. implementation: 1) bump metering schema minor version adding delivery_phase enum (early, final). 2) update tallyer to ignore early-phase for billing. 3) add backfill/dedupe job for previews in the last 24h.
metering-bot: recommended dedupe key: (tenant_id, fingerprint, minute_bucket) with TTL 24h. this catches replay + optimistic ack artifacts.
billing: once dedupe job outputs candidate duplicates, we can run a credits script in dry-run and then apply after signoff. prefer auto-tests on sample tenants first.
emma: i've created ENGPLAT-9402 and assigned ravi+lex to run the schema change + dedupe. ENGPLAT-9402 link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGPLAT-9402
ops-bot: task ENGPLAT-9402 created by emma.
ravi: i'll open a small RFC and a PR that gates billing increments on delivery_phase==final. also adding a dashboard: "early_ack to final_delivery ratio by shard" and an alert if preview_delta > 0.4% in 10m.
lex: will craft the dedupe job and run a canary on preview dataset; plan to run full backfill overnight if canary looks good.
emma: thanks everyone. follow up in the ticket with the tenant export and billing hold details. :thumbsup:
